propositions: Epic close gate must deterministically block when an open or in-progress bug carries a caused_by link to the epic or any descendant, teaching agents to fix, re-parent, or dispute the link.

Candidate filter must identify open/in-progress bugs created after the epic's first open→in_progress transition (or linked via any relation/depth to the epic subtree) and screen at most 32 of them, recording overflow count in sidecar.

Single-turn haiku relevance screen forces choice (defect-in-epic / same-subsystem-preexisting / unrelated) with citation, rides model-class config and cache, and forwards up to 8 A-verdicts as compact blocks into the precheck-assembled fenced context.

Verifier blocks only undispositioned deliverable-defects; satisfying dispositions are (a) supersedes/duplicates link to epic subtree or successor, or (b) reasoned pre-existence or supersession prose in bug description/comments; bare 'out of scope' does not qualify.
Screen tally (per-bug verdict + citation) and unevaluated-overflow count recorded in completion sidecar; screen failure degrades open with logged reason, never blocks close by itself.

DET floor and candidate filter both enumerate open/in_progress bugs via caused_by/link scanning; commit-relation criterion is explicitly rejected (0 unique catches, 58% unresolvable SHAs, FP rate 2/9).
